opus.problem: The cited verse (Daniel 1:8) only says Daniel would not defile himself with the king's food or wine. The request for vegetables and water is in Daniel 1:12, and being taken to Babylon as a young man is in Daniel 1:3-6. The clue goes beyond its reference.

Daniel 2:16 only says Daniel asked the king for time to give the interpretation. The order to kill the wise men (Daniel 2:12-13) and the friends praying for mercy (Daniel 2:17-18) are not in the cited verse.
Daniel 6:17 covers only the stone and the sealing. The king spending the night fasting and unable to sleep is in Daniel 6:18, so part of the clue is not supported by its reference.
